en: Black‑and‑white wartime postcard showing a damaged rural house with a sagging tiled roof and broken wooden walls, likely hit by artillery. Two soldiers in uniform stand in front of the ruined building; bare trees and a muddy, cratered foreground suggest a World War I battlefield landscape. Printed French text appears along the bottom margin identifying the publisher and the location in Alsace.
